definitions.explanation: The entirety of the United States. Almost always used as a modifier before another noun. 米 is the kanji abbreviation for アメリカ (America).

examples.japanese: {全米|ぜんべい}で{話題|わだい}になった。
examples.english: It became a topic of conversation across all of America.

examples.japanese: {全米|ぜんべい}オープンテニスが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The US Open tennis tournament has begun.

examples.japanese: その{映画|えいが}は{全米|ぜんべい}{興行|こうぎょう}{収入|しゅうにゅう}ランキングで1{位|い}になった。
examples.english: The film ranked number one in the US box office.

notes:
Almost exclusively used as a prefix or modifier. {米|べい} is the standard abbreviation for アメリカ in Sino-Japanese compounds, from {米国|べいこく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{全米|ぜんべい}1{位|い} (number one in America)
・{全米|ぜんべい}オープン (US Open)
・{全米|ぜんべい}{選手権|せんしゅけん} (US championship)
・{全米|ぜんべい}が{泣|な}いた (all of America cried — hyperbolic film marketing phrase)

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
・{全日本|ぜんにほん} / {全日|ぜんにち}: all of Japan
・{全英|ぜんえい}: all of Britain
・{全仏|ぜんふつ}: all of France
